placements.title: value shifts from rented substrate to owned, retained perspective
placements.frame: Does this expression locate the worth of an intelligence system in ownership and retained perspective rather than in the substrate it runs on or the terms under which that substrate is rented?
placements.why: src-2 states the categorical distinction ('Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence') and src-3 supplies the constitutive claim about what is kept ('the substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep'). Both are content-level assertions about where value resides in an intelligence system — a subject the document itself frames as a recurring thesis ('the individually-owned-intelligence thesis') meant to be connected to by future navigation, not a one-time fact or measurement. No existing strata or narrative leaf was supplied for this envelope (both structures are empty), and nothing in the perspective's map or focus section covers this theme (per the pass-2 settled binding), so this is a fresh subject with no close analog to extend, contradict, or see — it stands as a new, standalone leaf.
